svg.title: Degrading deliberately as the data thins out
svg.desc: Four levels. With enough international appearances a player's own record is used directly. Below a threshold the record is flagged as statistically unreliable and blended with performances from domestic leagues, downweighted because the standard differs. For a specific matchup between two players, fewer than a handful of deliveries faced means the pairing is abandoned in favour of each player's general rates. And where nothing exists, the model says so rather than producing a confident number. Each step down is declared in the output, so the person reading knows which one they are getting.
svg.text: the ordinary case, and the only one most models plan for
Flag as unreliable, blend in domestic leagues
downweighted, because the standard is not the same
too few deliveries in this exact matchup
Abandon the pairing, use general rates
a matchup built from four balls is noise wearing a number
Say so. Do not produce a number
Every step down is declared in the output,
so the reader knows which level of evidence they are looking at.
